README.md describes a continuously running global autoscaler that monitors Prometheus metrics and drives HPA/KEDA scaling. cmd/main.go starts a controller-runtime manager and configures health, metrics, Kubernetes clients, and autoscaling engines. The deployment manifest runs a controller-manager container and the service manifest exposes its metrics endpoint.
